rules: no user account is required to calculate
no calculation is persisted after page reload

routes.name: Calculator
routes.purpose: One-screen Downlight Calculator with dimension inputs, unit selection, optional spacing input, calculate action, and results card.

states.empty: before calculation, the result card is hidden and helper text says to enter room details
states.error: no backend error state is needed because no network request is made
states.loading: no loading state is shown because the calculator is local and instant
states.success: a result card shows the large downlight count, rows by columns layout, estimated spacing, spacing source, and disclaimer
states.validation: non-positive length, non-positive width, or non-positive preferred spacing shows a visible validation message

summary: Downlight Calculator is a clean one-screen tool that estimates downlight quantity, grid layout, spacing, and a guide-only disclaimer from room dimensions and optional preferred spacing.

deferred.reason: the request explicitly says no login and no persistence are needed
the requested output is only a basic guide and the disclaimer directs users to consider detailed design factors
regulations vary by location and the request only asks for a simple homeowner or tradesperson calculator

deferred.item: ceiling height, beam angle, lumens, dimming, room use, and fixture photometric inputs
deferred.reason: these factors are named for the disclaimer, not as requested calculator inputs

steps.expect: the one-screen calculator is visible with labelled inputs and a calculate button
the entered length and width remain visible in the inputs
the preferred spacing value remains visible in the input
a large result card shows the estimated downlight count, grid, spacing and disclaimer
visibleText: This is a guide only. Lighting design should consider ceiling height, beam angle, lumens, room use, and electrical regulations.

journeys.title: A user calculates downlights with a custom preferred spacing
acceptance: calculating a 6 m by 4 m room with 1.5 m preferred spacing visibly returns 12 downlights
the result visibly includes a 3 rows × 4 columns suggested layout
the disclaimer is visible in the result card

steps.expect: the calculator opens with preferred spacing empty and ready to use
visibleText: Leave blank to use the default

steps.expect: the entered dimensions are visible and preferred spacing is still blank

steps.action: press calculate while preferred spacing is blank
steps.expect: the result uses the sensible default spacing and shows the estimate
visibleText: This is a guide only. Lighting design should consider ceiling height, beam angle, lumens, room use, and electrical regulations.

journeys.title: A user calculates downlights without entering preferred spacing
acceptance: leaving preferred spacing blank still produces a visible downlight estimate
the result explicitly states that default 1.8 m spacing was used

steps.expect: the calculator shows a units selector
feet is visibly selected as the active unit
the entered room dimensions are visible
the preferred spacing in feet is visible
the result is shown using feet labels

journeys.title: A user calculates using feet instead of metres
acceptance: selecting feet changes the unit labels used in the result
a 12 ft by 10 ft room with 4 ft spacing visibly returns 9 downlights

steps.action: enter an invalid room length and a valid width
steps.expect: the entered values remain visible in the inputs
a visible validation message appears and no downlight count result is shown
visibleText: Enter a room length greater than 0

journeys.title: A user sees validation when dimensions are not usable
acceptance: a zero room length shows a visible validation message
invalid dimensions do not show a calculated downlight count

acceptance.statement: the home route shows the product name Downlight Calculator and labelled controls for room length, room width, units, preferred spacing, and calculate
a 6 m by 4 m room with 1.5 m preferred spacing returns visible text containing 12 downlights and 3 rows × 4 columns
a calculation result always displays the guide-only disclaimer mentioning ceiling height, beam angle, lumens, room use, and electrical regulations
leaving preferred spacing blank returns a visible estimate and states that default spacing was used
entering 0 for room length and pressing calculate shows Enter a room length greater than 0 and does not show a downlight count

operations.description: Calculate a transient downlight estimate from room dimensions, selected units, and optional preferred spacing.

responsibilities.behavior: Validate that roomLength and roomWidth are greater than 0. If invalid, write validationMessage and do not show a downlight count. If valid, use preferredSpacing when provided and greater than 0, otherwise use the default spacing of 1.8 metres or 6 feet. Calculate gridColumns as ceil(roomLength / spacing), gridRows as ceil(roomWidth / spacing), numberOfDownlights as gridRows multiplied by gridColumns, estimatedSpacing as the room length divided by gridColumns and room width divided by gridRows rounded to two decimals with the selected unit label, spacingSource as either custom spacing or default spacing, and disclaimer as the guide-only lighting design notice.
